findings.claim: No Brazilian beauty brand's stated launch-visual spend ≥R$2.500 or brief/RFP with such budget was found
findings.evidence_quote: (absence; trade-press searches returned only celebrity budgets such as Boca Rosa's R$1,2M campaign)

design_changes: Keep O LANÇAMENTO at R$2.990 as the list price for the test; it is 43,5% of the minimal verifiable traditional SP launch-with-film bill (R$6.878) and equals Make Move's AI minimum (R$3.000).

Redefine the unit as ONE LAUNCH (hero SKU + up to 2 supporting SKUs shown in the world) plus 1 kit composite; brands launch lines and kits (kits 12–78% of catalogues), so per-SKU pricing would bill an active brand R$45–270k/yr.
Lower A LINHA from R$6.900 to R$4.900 for up to 3 SKUs (or keep R$6.900 for up to 6 SKUs); traditional cost is per day, not per SKU, and R$6.900 exceeds her own LANÇAMENTO + 2×EXTENSÃO (R$4.370).
Keep VITRINE R$490 (inside the R$318–900 band for 6 styled images) and make it the first paid step with its price credited in full against O LANÇAMENTO within 30 days.
Keep EXTENSÃO R$690 and TEMPORADA R$9.900 (TEMPORADA offered only to repeat buyers).
Gate by CNPJ porte: offer LANÇAMENTO/LINHA to EPP and 'Demais' companies; ME brands are VITRINE-only.
Use products.json image counts as a free prospect signal (median ≤2 images per product = VITRINE lead; e.g., Dermare and Rosa Selvagem median 1).
Pre-commit a downshift product (LANÇAMENTO ESSENCIAL R$1.490, no film + FILME add-on R$990) instead of discounting R$2.990 on calls.

Use two anchor sentences on calls: traditional (R$1.250 studio period + R$1.500 model day + R$3.500 product video > R$6 mil) for brands that shoot; AI (R$53–60/image, Villo terms allow 'variações ... textuais') for brands that use AI/UGC.

Call-test bar: 20 pre-qualified brands; KEEP if ≥6/20 state ≥R$2.500 last-launch external spend AND (≥2 buy LANÇAMENTO or ≥4 buy VITRINE) within 30 days; DOWNSHIFT if <6 but ≥8/20 state ≥R$1.000; STOP if ≥12/20 state <R$1.000.
residual_risks: No buyer was observed paying ≥R$2.500 per launch for beauty visuals; seller-side anchors support the price, buyer-side money remains unobserved above US$500.
The traditional anchor applies only to brands that shoot traditionally; phone/UGC/AI brands anchor at R$53–250 per asset.
Anchors are partly apparel-studio (Estúdio Fábrica) and one stale union table (SINDCINE 2022/23, CADE: not enforceable); cosmetics-specialist premium still studios do not publish prices.
AI done-for-you studios in SP (Magotte R$1.080/20 images, Fábrica R$53/image, Make Move R$3.000) will get cheaper; the guarantee, film and claim lock are the only wedge.
ICP revenue is UNVERIFIED; porte only bounds it (EPP ≤ R$4,8M/yr). Two ICP brands are EPPs with R$10k capital opened 2024/2026.
